says: In today's CI, next/apps/fabrika/e2e/reload.test-support.integration.test.ts, a scheduled next-integration file added in 48c455d6c after the three measured runs, has no row in vitest.shards.full.json or vitest.shards.json. So the scheduled split counts it as the merge-line median, 0.4 s, and starts it last on its leg, the way watch.laws started before this fix. Nothing names a scheduled file that has no full-depth row.
proof: A node script at 1250d8a8d over nextFiles() and the two tables printed: next+integration files 331, full rows 330, no full row 1 ['next/apps/fabrika/e2e/reload.test-support.integration.test.ts'], no row at all 1 (the same file), median measured 0.4. The file runs runsFor({ fast: 3, full: 20 }) and runsFor({ fast: 8, full: 40 }) (lines 120 and 176).
cost: If that file, or the next new heavy integration file, is slow at full depth, a leg can start it too late and the job's limit cancels the leg again with no failed test: the sev1 this pull request fixes.
